id.description: ALRT-3. The Worker's own id for this Alert. Opaque to everyone else.

since.description: ALRT-3. When the condition began, as an RFC 3339 instant carrying an offset. It is what lets a console tell `this is new` from `this is the same thing as yesterday`, which is most of what dismissal was being asked to do.

summary.description: ALRT-3. Human-readable, and parsed by nothing. The reader this surface exists for is a person looking at a console; what a program acts on is the severity and the Actions.

actions.description: ALRT-3, ALRT-7. The Actions this Alert offers, by the names the Worker's own `actions` entry holds them under. May be empty. Names and not schemas, because the schema is already in that entry and a second copy is a second thing to keep in step.

title: Alert
description: ALRT-3. One condition an operator should see, while it holds.
